description: Lists large XRP Ledger payments (50,000+ XRP or major stablecoins) in a recent window of up to 120 minutes, each independently re-checked on the ledger, with an explicit note when the window is not fully covered. Useful for market and liquidity monitoring. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.02 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.
name: large_payments
title: Large Payments
